sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 % [llm27231]
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer, and for the care your skilled team puts into this part — we well understand the pressure that family-run foundries face as input costs move.

Regarding pump housing ph-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %. We value our cooperation and want to keep it on a fair footing, so we must ask you to reconsider.

We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price. We commit to a binding volume of 4,000 pcs per year over 24 months. Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best. Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and the binding volume, which allows us to optimize our production planning.
In return for the extended contract term and maintaining the 30-day payment period, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.30.
Could you please provide the binding release schedule for the 4,000 pieces so we can verify the volume data?
Which volume can you commit to?
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 % [llm27231]
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

thank you for your revised offer on pump housing ph-100 and for your willingness to work with our contract term and payment period. We understand your cost exposure and appreciate that you keep those figures internal. At the same time, the foundry wants +8.8 %.

We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price. Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best – both are attached for your review.

We commit to a binding volume of 4,000 pcs per year over 24 months, and we will provide the release schedule together with the order. We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

We have considered your position carefully. Our offer remains as set out in the attached packages. Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
